title: Negative control: declared properties named after schema keywords
description: Every schema keyword is a legal property name. The properties declared here are named maximum, $defs, $ref, type and x-authority, so a walk that mistakes the properties map for a schema object reads an attributed bound out of the property names alone. The one real bound is capacity's maximum, which carries no x-authority and must still be reported. This file exists to prove the walk tells a map of subschemas from a subschema; it is never loaded as a real schema.
